description: This Java source file defines the class RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponseSupplier, which supplies responses containing statistics details for a specific shard region in an Akka cluster. It interacts with Akka actors to retrieve shard region state, processes entity IDs to generate statistics, and constructs JSON responses.
